qualification: BVV DGM1/DOP20 supplies missing terrain and its appearance; DOM20/DGM1/DOP20 fits additional tree centres, heights and crowns. Branches and species are estimates. Outdoor cleanup is confined to the 20 m building approach and excludes surveyed buildings and roof overhangs. No interiors or neighbouring architecture are reconstructed in this pass.
